newsitem.title: USA: Claridge Hotels pays interest on mortgage notes.
newsitem.headline: Claridge Hotels pays interest on mortgage notes.

text.p: The Claridge Hotel and Casino Corp said on Tuesday it had made the interest payment due March 5 on its 11-3/4-percent notes due 2002.
Last month, the company that owns the Claridge Casino Hotel failed to make a scheduled February interest payment on notes.
Three noteholders with more than $10,000 worth of notes in the aggregate later filed a petition to force the company into bankruptcy.
But Claridge Hotels also said Tuesday that it had reached an agreement with an unofficial committee of its noteholders, whose members include those who filed the bankruptcy petition.
Under the agreement, it and the committee will jointly move to dismiss the bankruptcy petition and a related state court lawsuit, it said.
Claridge Hotels has been in acquisition talks with Hilton Hotels Corp, which owns up to 40 percent of its outstanding notes.
